title: Cattle mutilations in the Bigelow era

tellings.quote: uh during the Bigelow era, you know, my predecessor, they did have many cattle mutilation events where

plain: Skinwalker Ranch is a ranch in Utah known for reports of strange events, and its current owner, Brandon Fugal, spoke about it on a podcast. He says that while Robert Bigelow, the businessman who owned it before him, ran the place from about 1996 to 2016, there were many cattle mutilations, cows found dead and strangely cut, and that animal autopsy reports were made at the time. It is told as part of the case that something unexplained goes on at the ranch.
